product_type: Static HTML/CSS/JS website template, digital download, no build step required for ordinary buyer use
target_customer: Small manufacturing workshops with a laser cell
not_the_buyer: Medical, cosmetic, dermatology, hair-removal, surgical or eye/treatment laser businesses
Buyers expecting a full ERP, CRM, payments, inventory or nesting software
Buyers expecting guaranteed leads, exact automated pricing, or a physical product

stack.planner_engine: planner.js — pure functions, zero DOM access, UMD module usable in-browser and under Node's built-in test runner
stack.ui_wiring: app.js — the only file that touches document/window beyond reading SITE_CONFIG
stack.fonts: Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (display), Inter (body), JetBrains Mono (planner numeric values) — loaded via <link>, standard Google Fonts terms apply
stack.third_party_runtime_dependencies: None required for the core planner to function (verified: planner.js and app.js contain no network calls; Google Fonts and a Google Maps embed iframe are the only external requests on page load)

page_list.architecture: Single-page site with anchorable sections, plus four standalone pages
home_sections: Responsive navigation with mobile hamburger menu
Services overview (7 services: Laser Cutting, Laser Engraving, Signage, Acrylic Fabrication, Wood Engraving, Metal Marking, Corporate Gifts & Branded Products)
Project gallery (placeholder cards, not real photography)
Service area coverage (12 sample Cape Town areas)

theme_system.mechanism: Runtime CSS custom-property swap via a nav theme selector; selection persisted in localStorage under key 'plw-theme'

planner_inputs: Customer name, email, phone, suburb/city, project name
Service type (9 options: cutting, engraving, cutting & engraving, signage, acrylic fabrication, trophy/award, branded gift, prototype, other)
Material (9 options: acrylic, plywood, MDF, paper/card, leather, glass (engraving only), anodised aluminium (marking), stainless steel (marking), other)
Width, height, and a unit selector (mm/cm/m/inches)
Optional engraving area (same unit² as width/height)
Cut complexity (4 levels: simple outline, moderate detail, intricate detail, nested parts)
File readiness (4 levels: vector file ready, image file only, design help needed, no file yet)
File types available (7 checkboxes: SVG, DXF, AI, PDF, PNG, JPG, none yet)
Finish (5 options: raw edge, polished edge, painted, assembled, packaged)
Deadline (date), delivery preference (workshop collection / delivery), notes
planner_outputs: Approximate material area, unit-converted to cm²/m², per piece
Complexity indicator (Low/Medium/High, with contributing reasons shown)
Design-support warning whenever file readiness is anything other than 'vector file ready'
Preliminary budget range, only shown when planner.budgetEnabled is true in config
WhatsApp Quote Request and Email Quote Request actions
unit_conversion_behaviour: Width/height are converted to a common centimetre basis before area calculation: 1mm = 0.1cm, 1cm = 1cm, 1m = 100cm, 1 inch = 2.54cm. Area = (width in cm) x (height in cm), reported in cm² and m². Verified in code (planner.js unitFactor()) and by unit test (tests/planner.test.js: mm/cm/m/inches conversion cases, including a 10in x 10in -> 645.16cm² boundary check) and live in the browser.
budget_behaviour: Preliminary budget range = area(cm²) x material-rate-per-cm² (min and max) x thickness-band multiplier x cut-complexity multiplier x finish multiplier, plus a per-piece engraving surcharge (engraving area x material engrave-rate-per-cm²) added when the service type involves engraving or an explicit engraving area was given, multiplied by quantity, with a contingency percentage applied to the upper figure only, then rounded to the configured increment. All rates/multipliers/thresholds live in site-config.js under `planner` — none are hardcoded in planner.js. Verified live: 20cm x 10cm x 5mm acrylic, cutting & engraving, moderate detail, polished edge, qty 3 produced R1,050-R2,100, matching a hand-computed check exactly.
disabled_budget_behaviour: Setting planner.budgetEnabled to false in site-config.js hides the numeric budget range and shows 'Budget estimates are disabled for this demo' in its place. The scope, service checklist, file-preparation checklist, missing-information list, assumptions, and next-step recommendation are still produced. Verified by unit test (runPlanner disabled-budget-mode test) and by direct computeBudgetRange tests asserting enabled=false with min/max undefined.
whatsapp_behaviour: Clicking 'WhatsApp Quote Request' opens an explicit-confirmation modal (role=dialog, aria-modal=true) showing the exact outgoing message. Only after clicking 'Confirm & Send' does the site open a wa.me deep link (window.open) with the phone number stripped to digits and the message URL-encoded via encodeURIComponent. Nothing is sent automatically. Verified live: a patched window.open recorded zero calls before confirmation and exactly one correctly-encoded wa.me URL after clicking Confirm & Send.
email_behaviour: Clicking 'Email Quote Request' goes through the same explicit-confirmation modal, then navigates to a mailto: link built from the business email, a subject line, and the summary body, all URL-encoded via encodeURIComponent. This opens the visitor's own email client with a pre-filled draft; it does not send email automatically. A separate Quote Form (name/contact/service type/notes) also routes through the same confirm-before-WhatsApp-open flow.

print_download_copy_behaviour.copy: Uses navigator.clipboard.writeText when available, with a manual textarea-select fallback and a status message either way.
print_download_copy_behaviour.print: Adds a body class that print CSS rules use to hide everything except the summary block, then calls window.print().
print_download_copy_behaviour.download: Creates a Blob from the summary text and triggers a browser download of a .txt file named from the project name (sanitised to a safe filename) or a default name.

data_storage_behaviour: The site is entirely client-side with no backend and no server-side storage of any customer data. The only value persisted in the browser is the visitor's selected colour theme, stored in localStorage under the key 'plw-theme'. All planner inputs/outputs exist only in page memory until the visitor explicitly copies, prints, downloads, or confirms a WhatsApp/email handoff.

legal_disclaimers.quote_disclaimer_text: The planner provides preliminary guidance only. Final pricing depends on file quality, machine setup, material availability, job complexity, finishing, quantity, labour, delivery and final review.
legal_disclaimers.footer_disclaimer: States all business names, contact details, statistics and workshop-safety statements are fictional sample content, and that the Quote Planner produces preliminary, non-binding estimates only.
legal_disclaimers.legal_pages_are_starting_points: terms.html and disclaimer.html explicitly tell the buyer to have them reviewed by a qualified professional for their jurisdiction before publishing.

buyer_requirements: Not yet finalised in this repo — buyer-facing packaging (START-HERE, buyer guide, licence, AI disclosure, support boundaries) is produced in Phase 6 of this release process, not yet present as of this fact-check.
support_limits: Not yet finalised in this repo — to be defined in the Phase 6 buyer guide. No unlimited-support or free-custom-development claim should be made per commerce intake guidance.

live_demo_url_status: VERIFIED — HTTP 200, correct <title>, zero console errors, planner computes correctly, no mobile horizontal overflow, robots.txt/sitemap.xml/privacy.html all 200, unknown routes correctly serve the custom 404 (checked 2026-07-14 via curl and Chrome DevTools against the live deployment, not just localhost).
known_limitations: Project gallery ships with labelled placeholder cards, not real project photography, by design
All contact details, addresses, and workshop-safety statements are fictional sample placeholders that must be replaced before real business use
Legal pages (terms, disclaimer) are starting points only and need professional review for the buyer's jurisdiction
No testimonials, team profiles, or statistics sections are included, by design, to avoid unverifiable customer-rating or completed-project-count claims
